body: GITHUB HUGGING FACE MODELSCOPE DEMO DISCORD We are thrilled to release Qwen-Image, a 20B MMDiT image foundation model that achieves significant advances in complex text rendering and precise image editing. To try the latest model, feel free to visit Qwen Chat and choose “Image Generation”. The key features include: Superior Text Rendering: Qwen-Image excels at complex text rendering, including multi-line layouts, paragraph-level semantics, and fine-grained details. summaryZh: 通义千问正式发布了Qwen-Image，这是一个20B参数规模的MMDiT图像基础模型，在复杂文本渲染与精准图像编辑方面取得了显著突破。该模型支持多行布局、段落级语义及精细化细节处理，能够完美处理多种语言的文本排版需求。用户现在可以通过Qwen Chat的图像生成选项体验该最新模型，它标志着开源社区在图文生成对齐技术上的又一次重大升级。

glossary.explanationZh: 多模态Diffusion Transformer架构，用于处理图像生成任务的基础模型结构。
指模型在图像中准确生成和渲染特定文字内容的能力。
